- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Couscous has become popular in Spain, Italy, and Greece, appearing in salads, stews, and soups.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Moroccan tagine is a slow-cooked stew with meat, vegetables, and spices, served with couscous.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Greek moussaka is a layered dish with eggplant, ground meat, onions, and béchamel sauce, influenced by Ottoman cuisine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Spanish paella is a rice-based dish with seafood or meat, saffron, and vegetables, influenced by Arabic, Roman, and Moorish cultures.
